name: CreateDataTableNode
label: Create Data Table
description: Creates a new data table. If an existing data table is provided, it will be cloned.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table (Optional)
fields.description: An optional input data table to clone or use as a template.

fields.name: HasInitialColumns
fields.label: Initial Columns (Optional)
fields.description: An optional input to add initial columns in data table.

fields.name: Columns
fields.label: Data Table columns either number or comma seperated columns (Optional)
fields.description: An optional input data table columns to add in data table.

fields.name: HasEmptyRows
fields.label: Empty Rows (Optional)
fields.description: An optional input to add empty rows in data table.

fields.name: EmptyRows
fields.label: Data Table rows (Optional)
fields.description: An optional input empty rows to add in data table.

fields.name: NewDataTable
fields.label: New Data Table
fields.description: The newly created or cloned data table.
